fields.name: [ADD1] Street address
fields.desc: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

fields.name: [ADD2] Post office box number
fields.desc: The post office box number for PO box addresses. For example, DN7524.

fields.name: Locality
fields.desc: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. I.e, Mountain View.

fields.name: Region / State Code
fields.desc: Code of region or state in which the locality is, and which is in the country.

fields.name: Country ISO code
fields.desc: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, for example 'US'.

fields.name: Company
fields.desc: Company Name, leave empty for individuals

fields.desc: Type of the exception activity on record.

fields.name: Icon

fields.name: Activity State
fields.desc:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

fields.name: Barcode
fields.desc: Use a barcode to identify this contact.

fields.name: Normalized Email
fields.desc: This field is used to search on email address as the primary email field can contain more than strictly an email address.

fields.name: Employee
fields.desc: Check this box if this contact is an Employee.

fields.name: Group RFQ
fields.desc:
Define if RFQ should be grouped         together based on expected arrival, except for dropship operations.
         On Order: Replenishment needs will be grouped together except for MTO.
         Daily: Replenishment needs will be grouped if the expected arrival is the same day
         Weekly: Replenishment needs will be grouped if the expected arrival is the same week or week day
         Always: Replenishment needs will always be grouped.

fields.name: Has Tax ID
fields.desc: Technical field indicating whether the Tax ID is not a placeholder.Returns False for placeholder values such as '/', 'NA', 'na', or an empty string.

fields.name: Blacklist
fields.desc: If the email address is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing anymore, from any list

fields.name: Is a Company
fields.desc: Check if the contact is a company, otherwise it is a person

fields.name: Language
fields.desc: All the emails and documents sent to this contact will be translated in this language.

fields.name: Bounce
fields.desc: Counter of the number of bounced emails for this contact

fields.desc: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

fields.desc: If checked, new messages require your attention.

fields.desc: Over the past x days; the number of products received on time divided by the number of ordered products.x is either the System Parameter purchase_stock.on_time_delivery_days or the default 365

fields.name: Share Partner
fields.desc: Either customer (not a user), either shared user. Indicated the current partner is a customer without access or with a limited access created for sharing data.

fields.name: Timezone
fields.desc:
When printing documents and exporting/importing data, time values are computed according to this timezone.
If the timezone is not set, UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) is used.
Anywhere else, time values are computed according to the time offset of your web client.

fields.desc: Displays the custom unit for the products if defined or the selected unit of measure otherwise.

fields.name: Compare to Price
fields.desc: Add a strikethrough price to your /shop and product pages for comparison purposes.It will not be displayed if pricelists apply.

fields.name: Sales Description
fields.desc: A description of the Product that you want to communicate to your customers. This description will be copied to every Sales Order, Delivery Order and Customer Invoice/Credit Note

fields.name: Sales Description
fields.desc: A description of the Product that you want to communicate to your customers. This description will be copied to every Sales Order, Delivery Order and Customer Invoice/Credit Note

fields.name: Free To Use Quantity
fields.desc:
Available quantity (computed as Quantity On Hand - reserved quantity)
In a context with a single Stock Location, this includes goods stored in this location, or any of its children.
In a context with a single Warehouse, this includes goods stored in the Stock Location of this Warehouse, or any of its children.
Otherwise, this includes goods stored in any Stock Location with 'internal' type.

fields.name: Routes can be selected on this product
fields.desc: Routes can be selected on this product

fields.name: HS Code
fields.desc: Standardized code for international shipping and goods declaration.

fields.name: Incoming
fields.desc:
Quantity of planned incoming products.
In a context with a single Stock Location, this includes goods arriving to this Location, or any of its children.
In a context with a single Warehouse, this includes goods arriving to the Stock Location of this Warehouse, or any of its children.
Otherwise, this includes goods arriving to any Stock Location with 'internal' type.

fields.name: Invoicing Policy
fields.desc:
Ordered Quantity: Invoice quantities ordered by the customer.
Delivered Quantity: Invoice quantities delivered to the customer.

fields.name: Track Inventory
fields.desc: A storable product is a product for which you manage stock.

fields.name: Sales Price
fields.desc: Price at which the product is sold to customers.

fields.name: Valuation by Lot/Serial
fields.desc: If checked, the valuation will be specific by Lot/Serial number.

fields.name: Sales Price
fields.desc: The sale price can be set manually or computed from the product template. Click on the 'Configure Variants' button to set the extra attribute prices.

fields.name: Message Delivery error
fields.desc: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

fields.name: Number of errors
fields.desc: Number of messages with delivery error

fields.name: SMS Delivery error
fields.desc: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

fields.name: Action Needed
fields.desc: If checked, new messages require your attention.

fields.name: Nbr Moves In
fields.desc: Number of incoming stock moves in the past 12 months

fields.name: Nbr Moves Out
fields.desc: Number of outgoing stock moves in the past 12 months

fields.name: Outgoing
fields.desc:
Quantity of planned outgoing products.
In a context with a single Stock Location, this includes goods leaving this Location, or any of its children.
In a context with a single Warehouse, this includes goods leaving the Stock Location of this Warehouse, or any of its children.
Otherwise, this includes goods leaving any Stock Location with 'internal' type.

fields.name: Variant Price Extra
fields.desc: This is the sum of the extra price of all attributes

fields.name: Auto publish on
fields.desc: Automatically publish the page on the chosen date and time.

fields.name: Control Policy
fields.desc:
On ordered quantities: Control bills based on ordered quantities.
On received quantities: Control bills based on received quantities.

fields.name: Quantity On Hand
fields.desc:
Current quantity of products.
In a context with a single Stock Location, this includes goods stored at this Location, or any of its children.
In a context with a single Warehouse, this includes goods stored in the Stock Location of this Warehouse, or any of its children.
stored in the Stock Location of the Warehouse of this Shop, or any of its children.
Otherwise, this includes goods stored in any Stock Location with 'internal' type.

fields.name: Re-Invoice Costs
fields.desc: Validated expenses, vendor bills, or stock pickings (set up to track costs) can be invoiced to the customer at either cost or sales price.

fields.name: Delivery Time
fields.desc: Delivery lead time, in days. It's the number of days, promised to the customer, between the confirmation of the sales order and the delivery.

fields.name: Sequence
fields.desc: Gives the sequence order when displaying a product list

fields.name: Custom Lot/Serial
fields.desc:
If multiple products share the same prefix, they will share the same sequence, otherwise the sequence will be dedicated to the product.

    * Legend (for prefix):
    - Current Year with Century: %(year)s
    - Current Year without Century: %(y)s
    - Month: %(month)s
    - Day: %(day)s
    - Day of the Year: %(doy)s
    - Week of the Year: %(woy)s
    - Day of the Week (0:Monday): %(weekday)s
    - Hour 00->24: %(h24)s
    - Hour 00->12: %(h12)s
    - Minute: %(min)s
    - Second: %(sec)s

fields.name: Track Service
fields.desc:
Manually set quantities on order: Invoice based on the manually entered quantity, without creating an analytic account.
Timesheets on contract: Invoice based on the tracked hours on the related timesheet.
Create a task and track hours: Create a task on the sales order validation and track the work hours.

fields.name: Show On Hand Qty Status Button
fields.desc: Show On Hand Qty Status Button

fields.name: Cost
fields.desc:
Value of the product (automatically computed in AVCO).
        Used to value the product when the purchase cost is not known (e.g. inventory adjustment).
        Used to compute margins on sale orders.

fields.name: Tracking
fields.desc: Ensure the traceability of a storable product in your warehouse.

fields.name: Tracking Method
fields.desc: Technical field holding the tracking method. False on a storable product means it's tracked by quantity only.

fields.name: Product Type
fields.desc:
Goods are tangible materials and merchandise you provide.
A service is a non-material product you provide.

fields.name: Variants Default Code
fields.desc: Technical field to enhance performance when looking up default code of productvariants (LIKE/ILIKE)

fields.name: Forecasted Quantity
fields.desc:
Forecast quantity (computed as Quantity On Hand - Outgoing + Incoming)
In a context with a single Stock Location, this includes goods stored in this location, or any of its children.
In a context with a single Warehouse, this includes goods stored in the Stock Location of this Warehouse, or any of its children.
Otherwise, this includes goods stored in any Stock Location with 'internal' type.
